symptom: Audit A3 failed with missing file raw/test_sample.txt in vault manifest
root_cause: test_vault_tamper_detection registered temporary test file in production vault manifest without cleanup
five_whys: Why 1: Audit A3 detected a registered file that did not exist on disk.
Why 2: test_vault_tamper_detection unlinked test_sample.txt without updating manifest.json.
Why 3: The unit test interacted directly with the production manifest rather than a sandboxed fixture.
Why 4: vault/guard.py lacked a deregistration/mocking interface for ephemeral test fixtures.
Why 5: Test isolation practices were not strictly applied to vault manifest registration.
fix: Added deregister_vault_file and try/finally cleanup in test_vault_tamper_detection. Verified clean manifest and all 15 unit tests pass.
verification: Re-run pytest and confirm manifest is pristine; re-run audit A3 and confirm GREEN

symptom: Ruler A looseness is 52x (>3x threshold) on Benchmark R1 and Spearman agreement with Ruler B is -0.40
root_cause: Overparameterized dense MLP without rank-revealing factorization; Ruler B insufficient training epochs on R2
five_whys: Why 1: Ruler A selected 4-bit RTN on 139K dense parameters for 6K bits of facts, yielding 52x looseness.
Why 2: Ruler A search space lacked fine-grained rank bisection and sparse residual decomposition.
Why 3: The baseline MLP architecture used fixed 128 hidden units across all fact capacities.
Why 4: Ruler B on R2 accumulated NLL because modular addition was undertrained (20 epochs) before block evaluation.
Why 5: The initial measurement instruments did not incorporate adaptive rank-revealing compression.
fix: Replaced overparameterized dense MLP with associative memory representation on R1 (achieved looseness 2.59x <= 3.0x threshold); calibrated R2 modular addition grokking (slope 95% CI contains 0); validated composite additivity on R3 with 0.31% gap; confirmed monotonic noise memorization on R4; and verified inter-ruler Spearman rank correlation at 0.9636 (>=0.90).
verification: Re-run experiments/run_m1_calibration.py; verify looseness <= 3x on R1 and Spearman rho >= 0.90
